replies: The air is too heavy for a walk today, even a short one [K:exercise]. The air quality is currently severe, so children should stay inside to play [K:children-play]. You can try indoor play this afternoon instead [A:play-indoors].

The air is too heavy for a walk today, even a short one [K:exercise]. Fine particles strain the heart, so older people feel smog days most [K:older-heart]. It is best to skip early-morning walks on bad days [K:older-heart].

Older people are more sensitive to smog, so avoid early morning walks [K:older-heart]. Hard exercise increases the amount of smoke you breathe [K:exercise]. The air is cleaner from 12:00 to 17:00, so wait and walk then [K:exercise].

The air is currently at a severe level and is not suitable for opening windows [K:airing]. The air is cleanest in the early afternoon, so try opening them between 12:00 and 17:00 instead [K:airing]. Keep windows closed at other times to prevent outdoor smoke from entering your home [K:sealing].

Use a certified N95 or FFP2 mask that seals tightly around the nose and chin [K:mask-fit]. Pinch the nose clip and pull both straps to ensure no air escapes at the edges [K:mask-fit]. Have your son wear an N95 mask for the walk to school [A:mask-school-run].

A purifier keeps indoor PM2.5 levels a small fraction of the outside air [K:purifier-sizing]. In a sealed 30 m³ bedroom, a unit delivering 250 to 300 m³ of clean air per hour replaces the air eight times each hour [K:purifier-sizing]. You can also build a box-fan purifier using a HEPA-grade filter to achieve similar results for a lower cost [K:box-fan]. For your family, building a box-fan purifier for the bedroom will reduce PM2.5 exposure for the child and the grandparent by about 36% [A:diy-purifier]. Keep the bedroom door shut and run the device on medium all night [K:purifier-sizing].

Never keep an angithi burning in a room with the windows shut. Charcoal fires produce carbon monoxide, an odorless gas that can kill in a closed room [K:carbon-monoxide].

If you must use an angithi, keep a window open a crack for ventilation and extinguish the fire before you go to sleep [K:carbon-monoxide]. Never seal a room where an angithi is burning, as this causes dangerous carbon monoxide buildup [K:sealing]. 

Always keep your heater out of sleeping rooms to stay safe [A:heater-safety].

It is best to wait to open your windows. The air is usually worst during the morning rush and cleanest in the early afternoon [K:airing]. You can air the house for half an hour during the cleaner window later today [K:airing]. Please air the house in the clean window, not the morning [A:ventilate-window].

आज हवा सैर के लिए बहुत भारी है, थोड़ी देर के लिए भी नहीं [K:exercise]। बच्चों के स्वास्थ्य के लिए बाहर खेलना सुरक्षित नहीं है, क्योंकि वे बड़ों की तुलना में अधिक हवा अंदर लेते हैं [K:children-play]। आप बच्चों के लिए घर के अंदर खेलने का विकल्प चुन सकते हैं [A:play-indoors]।

हवा 12:00 से 17:00 तक ज़्यादा साफ़ है, तब तक रुकें और तभी टहलें [K:exercise]।

तेज़ व्यायाम से आप अधिक प्रदूषित हवा अंदर लेते हैं, इसलिए इसे दोपहर के साफ़ समय पर करें [K:exercise]। घर के बड़ों और बच्चों के लिए, अपनी सैर को इस साफ़ समय पर ले जाना बेहतर है [A:exercise-window]।
Please call 112 for emergency medical help now. Breathlessness, chest pain, wheezing that does not settle, confusion, or blue lips require urgent medical care [K:see-a-doctor].
